pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: You can attack in tandem with your troop, using your attacks to make openings for your troop to finish the job.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Prerequisite** expert proficiency with one or more weapons or unarmed attacks

You can attack in tandem with your troop, using your attacks to make openings for your troop to finish the job. When you make a Strike on your turn, any creature you hit takes a –1 status penalty to saving throws against any offensive ability your troop uses this turn.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Battlecry! — Creature Family Abilities: (Special Forces Bond) Combo Attack

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Special Forces Bond) Coordinated Casting
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: You can cast spells in tandem with your troop.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Prerequisites** You're a spellcaster, and your troop has spells or an offensive ability with the arcane, divine, magical, occult, or primal trait.

You can cast spells in tandem with your troop. When you Cast a Spell on your turn, any creature that you hit with a spell attack for the spell or that fails its save against your spell takes a –1 status penalty to AC, save DCs, and saving throws against any spell your troop Casts this turn or magical ability your troop uses this turn.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Battlecry! — Creature Family Abilities: (Special Forces Bond) Coordinated Casting

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Special Forces Bond) Desperate Fervor
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: When the chips are down, your troop becomes more dangerous.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Prerequisites** expert in Diplomacy, Intimidation, or Performance

When the chips are down, your troop becomes more dangerous. While your troop has 3 or fewer segments, it gains a +1 status bonus to AC, save DCs, and saving throws, and a status bonus to damage rolls equal to half your level. The damage bonus increases to your full level if the troop has only 2 segments.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Battlecry! — Creature Family Abilities: (Special Forces Bond) Desperate Fervor

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Special Forces Bond) Discipline
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Your troop automatically critically succeeds at rout checks.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Prerequisites** expert in Will saves

Your troop automatically critically succeeds at rout checks. If you're knocked unconscious, your troop still improves its degree of success on rout checks by one step until the end of the encounter, as a troop with a leader does.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Battlecry! — Creature Family Abilities: (Special Forces Bond) Discipline

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Special Forces Bond) Inescapable Troop
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Your troop locks down opposing forces, keeping them from repositioning on the battlefield.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Prerequisites** Reactive Strike

Your troop locks down opposing forces, keeping them from repositioning on the battlefield. Your troop gains the Inescapable Onslaught reaction.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Battlecry! — Creature Family Abilities: (Special Forces Bond) Inescapable Troop

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Special Forces Bond) Magical Defenses
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: You develop magical wards for your troops.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Prerequisites** You're a spellcaster.

You develop magical wards for your troops. Your troop gains a +1 status bonus to all defenses against magic.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Battlecry! — Creature Family Abilities: (Special Forces Bond) Magical Defenses

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Special Forces Bond) Mobile Troop
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Your troop can move across the battlefield nimbly.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Prerequisites** expert in Acrobatics

Your troop can move across the battlefield nimbly. When you and your troop are moving, the combined unit gains a +5-foot status bonus to all movement Speeds. In addition, if you or your troop uses a special action, spell, or other ability that allows a special type of movement, such as Wall Jump, translocate, or a fly Speed, you can move together even if that normally wouldn't be possible.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Battlecry! — Creature Family Abilities: (Special Forces Bond) Mobile Troop

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Special Forces Bond) Rage and Rule
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Your troop learns the incredible rush of raging in battle.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Prerequisites** You have the Rage action.

Your troop learns the incredible rush of raging in battle. When you Rage, your troop gains half the number of temporary Hit Points you do. These temporary Hit Points last for 1 minute, and the troop can't gain temporary HP from this ability again for 1 minute.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Battlecry! — Creature Family Abilities: (Special Forces Bond) Rage and Rule

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Special Forces Bond) Shield Wall
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: You've equipped your troop with shields, and they raise them at your command.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Prerequisites** Shield Block

**Requirements** You're wielding a shield.

You've equipped your troop with shields, and they raise them at your command. You Raise your Shield, and both you and your troop gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saves until the start of your next turn.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Battlecry! — Creature Family Abilities: (Special Forces Bond) Shield Wall

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Special Forces Bond) Troop Mascot
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Your troop finds your companion creature charming, and the members of your troop have bonded with your pet.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Prerequisites** You have a companion (such as an animal companion, eidolon, familiar, or pet).

Your troop finds your companion creature charming, and the members of your troop have bonded with your pet. Your companion gains resistance equal to your troop's level to all damage. If you have an eidolon, when an effect damages both of you, this resistance applies after you determine the higher amount of damage.

If you have an animal companion, its Support benefit applies to your troop as well as you.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Battlecry! — Creature Family Abilities: (Special Forces Bond) Troop Mascot

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Special Forces Bond) Under Command
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Leading troops is second nature to you, and the lessons of your tactics apply to entire groups of allies.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Prerequisites** You have the tactics class feature.

Leading troops is second nature to you, and the lessons of your tactics apply to entire groups of allies. Your troop counts as one of your squadmates and doesn't count against your maximum number of squadmates.

In addition, troops who are your squadmates can use an offensive ability instead of a Strike whenever you use a tactic that would allow them to Strike. If you specifically grant a melee Strike, they have to use an emanation ability; if you specifically grant a ranged Strike, they have to use a burst ability. They must use the 1-action or 2-action version of the offensive ability. These offensive abilities count against the number of Strikes you can grant with your tactic. This works with any troop squadmates, whether you're leading them or an ally is.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Battlecry! — Creature Family Abilities: (Special Forces Bond) Under Command

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Special Forces) Inescapable Onslaught
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Trigger A creature adjacent to the troop uses a move action that would cause it to no longer be adjacent
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Trigger** A creature adjacent to the troop uses a move action that would cause it to no longer be adjacent

**Effect** The troop uses the 2-action version of one of its offensive abilities that has an emanation, but only the triggering creature is affected. In addition, if the creature critically fails its saving throw, the move action is disrupted. If the offensive ability could be used only once per round, this reaction ignores that limit.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Battlecry! — Creature Family Abilities: (Special Forces) Inescapable Onslaught

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Abysium)
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.

**Abysium** (aura, poison) The stargut hydra emits an aura of nauseating radiation from the abysium in its body. Any creature that begins its turn within 30 feet of the stargut hydra is Sickened 1.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Howl of the Wild — Creature Family Abilities: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Abysium)

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Adamantine)
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.

**Adamantine** The stargut hydra's Strikes bypass Hardness and are treated as adamantine. The stargut hydra gains resistance 10 to physical damage (except adamantine).
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Howl of the Wild — Creature Family Abilities: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Adamantine)

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Djezet)
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.

**Djezet** (magical) The stargut hydra gains a +2 status bonus to saves against magic.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Howl of the Wild — Creature Family Abilities: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Djezet)

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Inubrix)
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.

**Inubrix** The stargut hydra's Strikes ignore resistance to damage from metal armor's armor specialization effects and do not trigger the Shield Block reaction or reactions from armor property runes.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Howl of the Wild — Creature Family Abilities: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Inubrix)

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Noqual)
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.

**Noqual** The stargut hydra's Strikes and abilities gain a +2 status bonus to damage against creatures with the ability to Cast a Spell.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Howl of the Wild — Creature Family Abilities: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Noqual)

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Orichalcum)
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.

**Orichalcum** When the stargut hydra has only two heads remaining, it is quickened. It can use the extra action only to Stride or Strike.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Howl of the Wild — Creature Family Abilities: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Orichalcum)

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Siccatite)
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
Each stargut hydra has at least one metamorphosis resulting from consuming a specific skymetal and internalizing its properties.

**Siccatite** After the stargut hydra takes fire damage, it becomes superheated, gaining immunity to fire and weakness 10 to cold. While superheated, cold damage can be used to cauterize a stump. After the stargut hydra takes cold damage, it becomes chilled, gaining immunity to cold and weakness 10 to fire.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Howl of the Wild — Creature Family Abilities: (Stargut Hydra) Skymetal Metamorphosis (Siccatite)

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Swarm Strider) Clinging Remnants
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: A swarm strider's melee Strikes and ranged Strikes made against targets within their weapon's first range increment deposit biting vermin on the target, dealing 1d4 persistent piercing damage,…
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description: A swarm strider's melee Strikes and ranged Strikes made against targets within their weapon's first range increment deposit biting vermin on the target, dealing 1d4 persistent piercing damage, increasing to 2d4 at 5th level, 3d4 at 10th level, 4d4 at 15th level, and 5d4 at 20th level.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Swarm Strider) Clinging Remnants

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Swarm Strider) Discorporate
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: When the swarm strider is reduced to 0 HP, their constituent creatures collapse, scattering on the ground under their space and each adjacent square.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
When the swarm strider is reduced to 0 HP, their constituent creatures collapse, scattering on the ground under their space and each adjacent square. If even one of the creatures gets away, the swarm strider can eventually re-form over 1d10 days (potentially longer in areas where there are few invertebrates).

The scattered invertebrates must be destroyed within 1 round to destroy the swarm strider permanently. The invertebrates have a collective pool of HP, typically equal to 1/4 of the swarm strider's maximum HP, and the same AC, saves, immunities, resistances, and weaknesses as the swarm strider. The invertebrates can't take actions but they escape automatically once the round elapses. At the GM's discretion, clever means of trapping or eliminating the creatures might be sufficient to destroy the swarm strider.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Swarm Strider) Discorporate

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Swarm Strider) Draw Bugs
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: The swarm strider draws more arthropods from the environment around them to reconstitute some of their damaged body.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description: The swarm strider draws more arthropods from the environment around them to reconstitute some of their damaged body. They regain the listed number of HP, which is typically 5 HP, increasing to 10 at 5th level, 15 at 10th level, and 20 at 15th level. At the GM's discretion, the swarm strider doesn't recover HP in areas where there aren't enough arthropods to call to themselves.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Swarm Strider) Draw Bugs

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Swarm Strider) Squirming Embrace
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: The swarm strider Strides.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description: The swarm strider Strides. If they end their movement sharing a space with a creature, they deal 1d6 piercing damage to the creature, with a basic Reflex save. The save DC is the high spell DC for the swarm strider's level. The damage increases by 1d6 at 4th level and every 3 levels thereafter. The swarm strider can Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim instead of Striding if they have the corresponding movement type.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Swarm Strider) Squirming Embrace

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Swarm Strider) Swarm Shape
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: The swarm strider collapses into a shapeless swarm of their constituent creatures.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description: The swarm strider collapses into a shapeless swarm of their constituent creatures. They drops all items in their possession. In this form, the swarm strider can't use attack actions and can't cast spells, but they can move through areas small enough for their constituent creatures to fit without having to Squeeze. They can use the same action to coalesce from their swarm shape back into their normal form.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Swarm Strider) Swarm Shape

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Union Organizer) Solidarity
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: 10 feet.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
10 feet.

While leading a demonstration, the union organizer grants themself and their allies a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against fatigue and mental effects. Greater numbers amplify the effect. The emanation increases to 20 feet if there are at least 5 allies within 10 feet, and to 30 feet if there are at least 10 allies within 20 feet.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: NPC Core — Creature Family Abilities: (Union Organizer) Solidarity

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Vampire, Nosferatu Overlord) Air of Sickness
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: 30 feet.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
30 feet. A creature entering or starting its turn in the aura must attempt a Fortitude save with a moderate DC for the nosferatu's level. On a failure, the creature is Sickened 1 and takes a –2 status penalty to saves made to resist diseases and remove the sickened condition for 1 hour.

Effect: Air of Sickness
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Vampire, Nosferatu Overlord) Air of Sickness

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Vampire, Nosferatu Overlord) Paralytic Fear
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Requirements The nosferatu overlord's last action was a successful claw Strike
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Requirements** The nosferatu overlord's last action was a successful claw Strike

**Effect** The nosferatu drags the target of the Strike close and freezes its mind in terror. The target must attempt a Will save with a moderate DC for the nosferatu's level.

**Critical Success** The target is unaffected.

**Success** The target is immobilized by fear until the end of the nosferatu's next turn.

**Failure** The target is restrained and takes a –2 circumstance penalty to its Fortitude DC against the nosferatu's Drink Blood ability until the end of the nosferatu's next turn.

**Critical Failure** As failure, and the target is Frightened 2.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Vampire, Nosferatu Overlord) Paralytic Fear

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Vampire, Nosferatu Thrall) Mindbound
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: A nosferatu master exerts a fierce hold over their thrall's mind.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description: A nosferatu master exerts a fierce hold over their thrall's mind. If any creature other than the thrall's master targets them with an effect that would give them the controlled condition, the thrall's master rolls a counteract check against it using their Dominate DC – 10 as the counteract check modifier.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Vampire, Nosferatu Thrall) Mindbound

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Vampire, Nosferatu Thrall) Mortal Shield
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Trigger The thrall's master would take damage from a Strike or spell attack and is in an adjacent square
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Trigger** The thrall's master would take damage from a Strike or spell attack and is in an adjacent square

**Effect** The thrall throws themself in front of their master, taking half the damage of the attack (before applying any weaknesses or resistances). The thrall's master takes the remaining damage, applying any weaknesses or resistances as normal.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Vampire, Nosferatu Thrall) Mortal Shield

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Vampire, Nosferatu Thrall) Rally
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Trigger The thrall ends their turn more than 30 feet away from their master
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Trigger** The thrall ends their turn more than 30 feet away from their master

**Effect** The thrall Strides up to their Speed toward their master.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Vampire, Nosferatu Thrall) Rally

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Change Shape
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: The nosferatu transforms into a swarm of pale-gray rats.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
The nosferatu transforms into a swarm of pale-gray rats. They gain a land Speed of 30 feet and a climb Speed of 10 feet, and they become Large. In this swarm form, the nosferatu can take an action to deal each enemy in the swarm's space 2d10 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save, with a high DC for the nosferatu's level. A creature that fails its save is also exposed to plague of ancients.

The monster changes its shape indefinitely. It can use this action again to return to its natural shape or adopt a new shape. Unless otherwise noted, a monster cannot use Change Shape to appear as a specific individual. Using Change Shape counts as creating a disguise for the Impersonate use of Deception. The monster's transformation automatically defeats Perception DCs to determine whether the creature is a member of the ancestry or creature type into which it transformed, and it gains a +4 status bonus to its Deception DC to prevent others from seeing through its disguise. Change Shape abilities specify what shapes the monster can adopt. The monster doesn't gain any special abilities of the new shape, only its physical form. For example, in each shape, it replaces its normal Speeds and Strikes, and might potentially change its senses or size. Any changes are listed in its stat block.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Change Shape

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Command Thrall
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Requirements One of the nosferatu's thralls is present and can hear the nosferatu
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Requirements** One of the nosferatu's thralls is present and can hear the nosferatu

**Effect** The nosferatu gives a single command to one of their thralls, which the thrall follows to the best of its ability during its next turn.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Command Thrall

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Dominate
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: The nosferatu can cast Dominate at will as a divine innate spell.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description: The nosferatu can cast Dominate at will as a divine innate spell. Casting it requires staring into the target's eyes, giving the spell the visual trait. The save DC uses a high DC for the nosferatu's level, and a creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to that nosferatu's Dominate for 24 hours. Fully destroying the nosferatu ends the domination, but merely reducing the nosferatu to 0 HP is insufficient to break the spell.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Dominate

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Drink Blood
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: The target creature's drained condition value decreases by 1 per week.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Requirements** The nosferatu's last action was a successful fangs Strike

**Effect** The nosferatu sinks their fangs into the targeted creature to drink its blood. This requires an Athletics check against the creature's Fortitude DC. On a success, the creature becomes Drained 1, and the nosferatu regains HP equal to 10% of their maximum HP, gaining any excess HP as temporary Hit Points. Drinking Blood from a creature that's already drained doesn't restore any HP to the nosferatu but increases the creature's drained condition value by 1, killing the victim when it reaches Drained 5. A nosferatu can also consume blood that's been emptied into a vessel for sustenance, but they gain no HP from doing so.

The target creature's drained condition value decreases by 1 per week. A blood transfusion, which requires a successful DC 20 Medicine check and sufficient blood or a blood donor, reduces the drained value by 1 after 10 minutes.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Drink Blood

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Nosferatu Vulnerabilities
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: - Revulsion A nosferatu can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of brandished garlic or a brandished religious symbol of a deity with a holy sanctification option.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
- **Revulsion** A nosferatu can't voluntarily come within 10 feet of brandished garlic or a brandished religious symbol of a deity with a holy sanctification option. To brandish garlic or a religious symbol, a creature must Interact to do so for 1 round (similar to Raising a Shield). If the nosferatu involuntarily comes within 10 feet of an object of their revulsion, they gain the fleeing condition, running from the object of their revulsion until they end an action beyond 10 feet. After 1 round of being exposed to the subject of their revulsion, a nosferatu can attempt a DC 25 Will save as a single action, which has the concentrate trait. On a success, they overcome their revulsions for 1d6 rounds (or 1 hour on a critical success).
- **Stake** A magical wooden stake (such as one affected by a weapon *potency rune*, Runic Weapon, or similar magic) driven through the nosferatu's heart drops the nosferatu to 0 HP and prevents them from healing above 0 HP, even in their coffin. Staking a nosferatu requires 3 actions and works only if the nosferatu is unconscious. If the stake is removed, the nosferatu can heal above 0 HP again, and if they're in their coffin, the 1-hour rest period begins once the stake is removed. If the nosferatu's head is severed and anointed with Holy Water while the stake is in place, the nosferatu is destroyed.
- **Sunlight** If exposed to direct sunlight, a nosferatu immediately becomes Slowed 1. The slowed value increases by 1 each time the nosferatu ends their turn in sunlight, and the condition ends when they're no longer in sunlight. If the nosferatu loses all their actions in this way, they're destroyed.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Nosferatu Vulnerabilities

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Plague of Ancients
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Saving Throw Fortitude (use a high DC for the nosferatu's level)
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
**Saving Throw** Fortitude (use a high DC for the nosferatu's level)

**Onset** 1 day

**Stage 1** Drained 1 (1 day)

**Stage 2** Drained 2 and Enfeebled 2 (1 day)

**Stage 3** Doomed 1, Drained 3, and Enfeebled 3 (1 day)

**Stage 4** Doomed 2, drained 3, and enfeebled 3 (1 day)

**Stage 5** unconscious (1 day)

**Stage 6** death
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Plague of Ancients

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Plagued Coffin Restoration
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Unlike other undead, a nosferatu isn't destroyed at 0 HP.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description: Unlike other undead, a nosferatu isn't destroyed at 0 HP. Instead, they disperse into an immense number of rats heading in every direction in an attempt to return to their coffin. If even a single rat reaches the coffin, the nosferatu can recover. A nosferatu regains their strength through resting in earth taken from the grave of a creature that died of plague. If their body rests in their earth-filled coffin for 1 hour, the nosferatu gains 1 HP, after which their fast healing begins to function normally. If the coffin doesn't contain this plagued grave dirt, they instead need to rest in their coffin for 1 day before they gain 1 HP and regain their fast healing.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Vampire, Nosferatu) Plagued Coffin Restoration

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Warden of the Wild) Voice of Nature
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: Though the Wardens of the Wild do not speak in words, they can communicate complex concepts flawlessly and wordlessly with any animal, beast, plant, or other creature of the natural world through…
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description: Though the Wardens of the Wild do not speak in words, they can communicate complex concepts flawlessly and wordlessly with any animal, beast, plant, or other creature of the natural world through prolonged eye contact. Sapient creatures with strong ties to the natural world, such as animal instinct barbarians or druids who speak the Wildsong, can somewhat understand a Warden of the Wild, though the meaning can be vague.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Howl of the Wild — Creature Family Abilities: (Warden of the Wild) Voice of Nature

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Warden of the Wild) Warden's Crown
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: A Warden of the Wild's horned crown commands respect from wild creatures.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description: A Warden of the Wild's horned crown commands respect from wild creatures. Wild creatures native to a warden's biome automatically improve their attitude toward it by one step (up to friendly) and typically do not take hostile actions towards each other while in the warden's presence.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Howl of the Wild — Creature Family Abilities: (Warden of the Wild) Warden's Crown

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Zombie) Ankle Biter
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: This zombie fights just as well on the ground as it does standing.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description: This zombie fights just as well on the ground as it does standing. While prone, the zombie isn't off-guard, it ignores the status penalty to its attack rolls, and it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to Athletics checks to Trip. The zombie can also move up to half its Speed when it Crawls.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Zombie) Ankle Biter

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Zombie) Persistent Limbs
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: The first time the zombie is critically hit with a melee or ranged Strike, a limb falls off its body and continues to attack.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description: The first time the zombie is critically hit with a melee or ranged Strike, a limb falls off its body and continues to attack. The limb acts on the zombie's initiative; each round it can Stride up to half the zombie's Speed and make a Strike. The limb uses and contributes to the zombie's multiple attack penalty.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Zombie) Persistent Limbs

pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.name: (Zombie) Putrid Stench
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.summary: 15 feet.
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.description:
15 feet. The zombie's rotting flesh is particularly malodorous. A creature that enters the area must attempt a Fortitude save. On a failure, the creature is Sickened 1, and on a critical failure, the creature also takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 round. While within the aura, the creature takes a -2 circumstance penalty to saves to recover from the sickened condition. A creature that succeeds at its save is temporarily immune to all zombies' putrid stenches for 1 minute.

Effect: Putrid Stench
pf2e-orc.monster-abilities.cite: Monster Core 2 — Creature Family Abilities: (Zombie) Putrid Stench

pf2e-orc.familiar-abilities.name: Alchemical Gut
pf2e-orc.familiar-abilities.summary: Your familiar can act as a Bomb Coagulant Alembic by swallowing the bomb to be affected, which takes two Interact actions from it and one from you.
pf2e-orc.familiar-abilities.description: Your familiar can act as a Bomb Coagulant Alembic by swallowing the bomb to be affected, which takes two Interact actions from it and one from you. Your familiar regurgitates the concentrated item 1 minute later. If your familiar tries to distill a bomb that's level is higher than your own –1, it instead takes damage as though it were successfully struck with the bomb.
pf2e-orc.familiar-abilities.cite: Treasure Vault (Remastered) — Familiar Abilities: Alchemical Gut

pf2e-orc.familiar-abilities.name: Familiar of Nimble Flight
pf2e-orc.familiar-abilities.summary: Even if your familiar doesn't have wings, it can sometimes move as if carried aloft by the wind.
pf2e-orc.familiar-abilities.description: Even if your familiar doesn't have wings, it can sometimes move as if carried aloft by the wind. When you Cast or Sustain a hex, your familiar can Fly up to 15 feet; this movement doesn't trigger reactions.
pf2e-orc.familiar-abilities.cite: Howl of the Wild — Familiar Abilities: Familiar of Nimble Flight

pf2e-orc.familiar-abilities.name: Familiar of Overwhelming Tides
pf2e-orc.familiar-abilities.summary: Your familiar constantly drips with ocean water.
pf2e-orc.familiar-abilities.description: Your familiar constantly drips with ocean water. When you Cast or Sustain a hex, you can cause a small wave to surge forth from your familiar. One creature within 10 feet of your familiar is pushed 5 feet away from your familiar.
pf2e-orc.familiar-abilities.cite: Howl of the Wild — Familiar Abilities: Familiar of Overwhelming Tides

pf2e-orc.familiar-abilities.name: Familiar of Parasitic Might
pf2e-orc.familiar-abilities.summary: Your familiar appears gaunt and malnourished or otherwise on the brink of death, even though it's quite healthy.
pf2e-orc.familiar-abilities.description: Your familiar appears gaunt and malnourished or otherwise on the brink of death, even though it's quite healthy. When you Cast or Sustain a hex, your familiar can draw on the waning strength of another to sustain itself. One creature within 15 feet of your familiar with less than half of its maximum Hit Points becomes Sickened 1 unless it succeeds at a Fortitude saving throw against your spell DC.
pf2e-orc.familiar-abilities.cite: Howl of the Wild — Familiar Abilities: Familiar of Parasitic Might

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Automated Cycle
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 5 feet long, 10 feet wide, 3 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This clockwork cycle provides most of its mobility via cogs and gears, which allow the cycle to move at a reasonable pace without the need for significant pedaling effort on the part of the pilot. The pilot uses a system of pedals and steering to control the speed and direction of the vehicle. The vehicle comes equipped with two sidecars, one on each side of the pilot.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Battery Tower
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 50 feet long, 50 feet wide, 90 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: Black powder siege towers use the same rules as other siege towers.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Clunkerjunker
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 10 feet long, 5 feet wide, 5 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: A favorite of goblins, a clunkerjunker is essentially an armored cart built out of junk that uses volatile flammable chemicals, explosions, and alchemical reactions to propel itself bumpily along. While the initial idea is impressive and the cost of creating one is surprisingly low, these junkers, unfortunately, have a strong tendency to malfunction, and they're always one bad bump away from disaster.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Adaptable Paddleboat
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 10 feet long, 5 feet wide, 4 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.pilotingCheck: Driving Lore (DC 16), Sailing Lore (DC 16), or Crafting (DC 18)
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This amphibious clockwork boat moves through the water using clockwork waterwheels to keep a slow, consistent pace. When necessary, the boat uses ingenious clockwork to reposition the waterwheels and transform them into wheels suitable for land.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Steam Cart
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 10 feet long, 5 feet wide, 4 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: A steam cart looks like a cart with an alchemical cauldron that produces steam to power the cart's movement through a simple engine.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Two-Person Submersible
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 10 feet long, 5 feet wide, 5 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This clockwork vehicle can travel just below the surface of the water for short periods of time to bypass enemy blockades or covertly land on enemy beaches.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Clockwork Wagon
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 10 feet long, 10 feet wide, 7 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: A clockwork wagon is a slow, bulky wagon with cogs and gears running all along its interior and exterior, allowing it to pull about twice as much cargo as an ordinary wagon. However, it has less passenger space than an ordinary cart.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Sand Diver
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 15 feet long, 6 feet wide, 6 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: A sand diver is a vaguely scorpion-shaped vehicle that uses alchemical reactions to propel itself. The tail-like structure acts as a heat sink and releases alchemical fumes behind the diver as it burrows. Instead of pincers, it has two burrowing mechanisms in front that allow it to dig through sand.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Air Cycle
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 10 feet long, 10 feet wide, 5 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This clockwork vehicle consists of a small wheeled platform under a pair of wings made with a light wooden frame covered by sturdy cloth. An air cycle must be launched from a high altitude, similar to a glider. Once airborne, however, the air cycle can be kept aloft and controlled using a system of pedals and steering handles to control its speed and direction. If you stop pedaling the air cycle, it functions as a glider.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Caisson
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 10 feet long, 10 feet wide, 10 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This heavily armored wagon is designed to transport black powder and other flammable munitions in and around combat zones. It has extra armor plating that increases its weight to several times that of an ordinary wagon. Due to this extra weight, the armored wagon is quite slow.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Floating Camouflage Blind
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 10 feet long, 10 feet wide, 10 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: The floating camouflage blind comprises a wooden platform fastened to a pair of pontoons and is powered by a small clockwork motor. On this platform are four short walls, with a canvas cover providing protection from the elements. Typically, the outside of the blind is painted to blend in with any surrounding foliage. Floating camouflage blinds are often placed near the mouth of strategic waterways so that traffic can be stealthily monitored.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Steam Trolley
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 15 feet long, 10 feet wide, 8 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: A steam trolley is essentially a much bigger steam cart, with a heavier-duty alchemical cauldron and furnace feeding into a larger steam engine.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Armored Carriage
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 10 feet long, 10 feet wide, 10 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: Slow but steady, an armored carriage combines clockwork with a protective hull for a safe and comfortable ride.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Firefly
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 10 feet long, 10 feet wide, 10 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: A firefly blends magic and technology, using electricity magic and magnetism to hover just above the ground. While a firefly is more box-like than insect-shaped, it gets its name from the constant glow of the light and electricity magic that power it, as well as from the stabilizing magnets that protrude from its sides in roughly the same position as wings would be.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Backpack Balloon
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 5 feet long, 5 feet wide, 5 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: What appears to be a simple, if bulky, backpack conceals clockwork devices that can inflate two large balloons, carrying the backpack's wearer through the air for brief periods of time. In addition, propellers allow the pilot to move while airborne.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Clockwork Hopper
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 10 feet long, 10 feet wide, 12 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: A clockwork hopper is similar in form to a large rabbit, making hop-like strides that avoid terrain impediments, though the lurching hops can be bumpy and cause motion sickness in some riders.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Combat Kite
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 20 feet long, 20 feet wide, 10 feet high

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Iceboat
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 10 feet long, 10 feet wide, 20 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: In addition to sailing across open water, this vessel can also travel at high speeds over frozen rivers, lakes, oceans, and fjords.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Medical Wagon
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 10 feet long, 10 feet wide, 5 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.speed: the Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 1 Large creature)
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: Medical wagons are frequent sights near the battlefield. These wagons carry various mundane and magical medical supplies and are generally staffed by a medic. A small gurney is mounted in the back of the wagon for transporting personnel or for use as an emergency operating table.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Snail Coach
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 30 feet long, 10 feet wide, 15 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: Shaped like its animal namesake, a snail coach is a trolley powered by a combination of magic and alchemical adhesives, with a hard outer shell to protect itself from attacks. The adhesive trail both allows it to climb and leaves a hindrance for pursuing foes.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Mobile Inn
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 20 feet long, 20 feet wide, 13 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.passengers: 3 (can hold up to 5 by stripping accommodations)
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: A mobile inn is the next step up from an armored carriage, bringing the limited comforts of a simple (and cramped) inn stay to make long distance journeys more bearable for wealthy travelers. Essentially a tiny inn on wheels, powered by alchemical catalysts and a steam engine, the vehicle is equipped with a stove, storage cupboard, washbasin, table, two benches, and a compact sleeping loft large enough to accommodate four. It can be modified to accommodate a single passenger in significantly more comfort or to easily hold 5 passengers by stripping the accommodations.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: War Wagon
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 15 feet long, 15 feet wide, 5 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.pilotingCheck: Driving Lore (DC 24) or Nature (DC 26 to DC 34 depending on the pulling creatures
pf2e-orc.vehicles.speed: the Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 6 Large creatures)
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: Often adorned with spikes and other defensive countermeasures, a war wagon is an intimidating sight on any battlefield. It can carry both soldiers and a siege weapon.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Clockwork Borer
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 20 feet long, 8 feet wide, 8 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: A clockwork borer is essentially a huge adamantine drill attached to a large wheeled carriage. The clockwork gears within move the borer itself and spin the drill, allowing it to burrow through loose material quickly and even through solid stone at a slower rate.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Nighthawk
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 15 feet long, 15 feet wide, 10 feet high

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Speedster
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 10 feet long, 5 feet wide, 5 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: A speedster is a light streamlined hybrid clockwork and steam-powered alchemical chassis roughly the shape of a horse or other creature built for speed. Speedsters are built to maintain a rapid pace that can become even faster for brief periods of time by releasing stored up steam pressure for an extra burst of speed.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Apparatus of the Octopus
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 10 feet long, 10 feet wide, 5 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.passengers: 1 (the passenger can optionally act as crew but more crew isn't necessary)
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This apparatus, which is shaped like an octopus (or more rarely, a squid or other aquatic creature), uses almost entirely magical propulsion. Clockwork parts make up the controls and mechanisms to improve some of the functionality, but magic moves the vehicles' cogs and gears. While it needs only a pilot, it can optionally hold a second crew member, which can be useful if the second crew member controls the apparatus's hands or eyes.
pf2e-orc.vehicles.cite: Guns & Gears (Remastered) — Vehicles: Apparatus of the Octopus

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Skimmer
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 20 feet long, 15 feet wide, 35 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.speed: swim 30 feet or 60 feet using hydrofoil (wind)
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This sleek vessel generally appears as a fast-moving catamaran. Using a pair of clockwork mechanisms, the main hulls can be lifted out of the water, with only the narrow blade of their keels remaining slightly below the surface, turning the skimmer into an even faster hydrofoil, doubling its normal speed.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Combat Catamaran
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 40 feet long, 40 feet wide, 80 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.speed: swim 30 feet or 50 feet using spinnakers (wind)
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This high-speed sailing ship is designed to track down fleeing vessels. When traveling downwind, the combat catamaran can deploy a pair of huge kite-like spinnakers that dramatically increase its speed.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Ambling Surveyor
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 15 feet long, 15 feet wide, 20 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This huge, magical clockwork rover moves on a continuous band of heavy treads, which make it easier to for the device to navigate across various adverse conditions. It contains magical clockwork birds which can transmit visual information back to the surveyor.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Sky Chariot, Armored
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 20 feet long, 20 feet wide, 10 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.pilotingCheck: Arcana (DC 34), Nature (DC 34 to 42 depending on the pulling creature), or Piloting Lore (DC 32)
pf2e-orc.vehicles.speed: the fly Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 6 Large creatures, 2 Huge creatures, or 1 Gargantuan creature)
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This open-air vehicle is constructed similar to a sleigh, with four wheels in the place of runners and a set of sweeping wings extending from its sides. The wooden body of the vehicle is armored to protect the occupants, who can fire handheld weapons over the gunwales to gain cover from ranged attacks.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Combat Transport
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 80 feet long, 60 feet wide, 30 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: These massive vehicles incorporate multiple gas filled bladders and clockwork technology to quickly deploy troops in battle. With a large fuselage bracketed by equally large gas bladders, combat transports utilize both aft-mounted and bottom-mounted clockwork fans to move and hover.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Necro Roamer
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 15 feet long, 15 feet wide, 15 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: Favored by necromancers, this vehicle is a heavily fortified, armored wooden shed mounted on the legs of a dozen undead creatures.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Titanic Stomper
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 60 feet long, 30 feet wide, 60 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: Titanic stompers were meant to devastate the armies of the undead.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Battle Dirigible
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 50 feet long, 50 feet wide, 100 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: These heavily armored rigid airships are carried aloft by a series of massive gasbags carried within the framework of their hull, protected from damage by a hide and metal skin. Used to control the battlefield from the air, these airships carry both their own armaments as well as one or more gliders mounted on rails for quick deployment along the sides and top.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Clockwork Castle
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 30 feet long, 30 feet wide, 35 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: While the name slightly overstates its size, nonetheless a magical clockwork castle is a sizable mobile fortress built on ten spiderlike clockwork legs, with three stories of palatial accommodations within. Legends tell of a unique clockwork castle massively larger even than this size, perhaps an artifact in its own right.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Mobile Command Post
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 90 feet long, 50 feet wide, 20 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This utilitarian vehicle resembles a small encampment, complete with protective barriers, a kitchen, sleeping quarters, and partitioned offices, all mounted on ironclad timbers. Beneath these timbers is a series of cogs and wheels, enclosed by a solid chain track made of iron plates. These tracks enable the mobile command post to move over all types of terrain, albeit at a slow pace. Once in position, these tracks fold up, allowing the vehicle's base to rest on the ground while providing extra protection along the sides of the vehicle.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Steam Turtle
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 80 feet long, 50 feet wide, 40 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This heavily armored aquatic vehicle resembles a gargantuan sea turtle covered with steel plates. The steam turtle is designed for beach landings and assaults on port facilities. Once it disables enemy fortifications, it extends a long boarding gangplank for troops to disembark and deploy.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Armored Sleigh
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 50 feet long, 30 feet wide, 20 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.pilotingCheck: Driving Lore (DC 36) or Nature (DC 38 to DC 46, depending on pulling creatures)
pf2e-orc.vehicles.speed: the Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 4 Huge creatures)
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: Designed to traverse frozen climates, armored sleighs are constructed from heavy oaken timbers covered with iron. These massive vehicles can readily traverse frozen and snow-covered ground while protecting the pilot and crew from the cold.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Flying Submersible
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 60 feet long, 40 feet wide, 40 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This tubular vehicle flies with the aid of a pair of large gas-inflated balloons. With a clockwork-powered aft propeller, the vehicle can move forward if there are no extreme headwinds. Upon landing in the water, the balloons are deflated and stowed within the vehicle, while the aft propeller continues to move it on the surface of the water. By filling a long ballast tank in the vehicle's keel, it can then submerge and travel underwater. The vehicle can stay submerged for only 1 hour until it must resurface to refresh its oxygen supply. The weapons of this vehicle are in a special compartment that allows them to be fired and reloaded underwater.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: War Strider
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 20 feet long, 20 feet wide, 40 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This massive steam-powered vehicle resembles a giant insect with six articulated legs topped with a bulbous turret capable of swiveling 360 degrees to bring its forward-mounted weapons to bear on enemies in any direction. It has weapon ports on either side of its head that give the appearance of eyes. With its long, mechanized legs, it can easily climb over obstacles and cross wide chasms.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Siege Barge
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 60 feet long, 30 feet wide, 20 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.pilotingCheck: Nature (DC 41 to 46 depending on the pulling creatures) or Sailing Lore (DC 39)
pf2e-orc.vehicles.speed: the Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 4 Huge creatures)
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: These special barges were designed to siege river and oceanside fortresses and enemy encampments. In addition to carrying two huge siege weapons and their crews, these barges also hold a variety of stones and other siege projectiles.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Siege Dragon
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 30 feet long, 30 feet wide, 20 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: Crafted to appear as a chunky adamantine dragon at a distance, this vehicle is designed to scare civilians and intimidate enemy armies on the battlefield below.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Steelstone Assault Engine
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 30 feet long, 20 feet wide, 20 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This steam-powered vehicle has eight sets of axles, each with a pair of huge, spiked metal wheels that are independently powered and can independently shift up and down. This enables the engine to maintain a constant speed even over difficult terrain. On top of the vehicle sits a rotating weapon mount outfitted with a steelstone cannon.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Cavern Crawler
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 50 feet long, 50 feet wide, 30 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This massive undead vehicle is created by crafting a piloting and cargo compartment within the husk of a massive cave worm and then infusing the remains with void energy. This compartment has breathable air as well as sealable weapon ports. Designed specifically to burrow under and then behind enemy positions, cavern crawlers can attack enemies on their flank or bring supplies and reinforcements to troops deep behind enemy lines.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Cook's Caravan
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 100 feet long, 30 feet wide, 20 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.pilotingCheck: Driving Lore (DC 40) or Nature (DC 42 to DC 45 depending on the pulling creatures)
pf2e-orc.vehicles.speed: the Speed of the slowest pulling creature (pulled by 12 Large creatures)
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: An army travels on its stomach, and this wagon train is designed to keep that stomach full. Composed of five heavy wagons connected via a series of flexible corridors, this caravan carries provisions and provides dining services for troops. The lead and middle wagons contain full-service galleys while the second and fourth wagons are stocked to the brim with foodstuffs. The last wagon in the caravan contains a boiler and scullery services for cleaning kitchen utensils and dishes. On the roof of each wagon is an herb garden to ensure a fresh supply for all meals, and mounted beneath all wagons are water and beer storage. Each cook's caravan carries enough supplies to feed its crew, passengers, 12 Large creatures, and 500 soldiers for a month before needing to be restocked.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Flying Fortress
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 70 feet long, 80 feet wide, 70 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: The ultimate battlefield command center, this massive skyborne castle serves as a platform for launching aerial assaults on land-based and sea-based enemy positions. By hovering over an enemy position, the flying fortress can lay waste to enemies who lack countering siege weapons by firing down on their frontline defenses.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Ice Breaker
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 120 feet long, 40 feet wide, 50 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.speed: swim 40 feet or 20 feet in heavy ice (clockwork, magical)
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: Colder oceans are often beset with heavy layers of sea ice, providing some kingdoms natural barriers to sea-based assaults and bombardments. To counter this, as well as to resupply troops in these areas, engineers designed massive steam-powered ice breakers. Powered by a dozen steam boilers lit with arcane flames, these ships can make their way through heavy ice fields that would crush most vessels, leaving an open channel behind them for other ships to follow.

pf2e-orc.vehicles.name: Ironclad
pf2e-orc.vehicles.space: 50 feet long, 100 feet wide, 20 feet high
pf2e-orc.vehicles.description: This heavy gunboat features solid hardwood timbers covered with thick iron plates riveted together to protect the portions of the vessel above the waterline. These timbers slope inboard at an angle to reduce the effectiveness of siege projectiles and cannon shots. The vessel is powered by a twin pair of propellers spun by steam from boilers that are magically fired, yielding glowing blue smoke through its twin pair of smokestacks. Ironclads are so formidable that a single one has been known to blockade an entire port by itself against more traditional wooden ships.
